List labels or fetch one by name
Retrieves labels from a repository on GitHub or GitLab. Supplying `-Name` returns the single matching label.
GitHub fetches a named label directly; GitLab lists the labels and matches on name, so the result is the same but the request count is not.
Forge provider (github, gitlab). Auto-detected from git remote if not specified
Group or organization identifier. Gitlab only; Github labels are repository-scoped
